run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a callable over 100 iterations and print average ms
test_time_func_warmup: test time_func warmup phase runs 5 iterations before timing the benchmark
test_time_func_iterations: test time_func with a custom number of iterations for benchmarking
review_time_func_timing: review time_func to understand how perf_counter measures average execution time in ms
summarize_time_func: summarize time_func which benchmarks a function with warmup and reports average ms per call
